text:
maria_sales: Quick update for Acme Health call at 3pm — they want a clear pass/fail for performance before signing. I ran the summary with ENG, posting results and next steps.

tyler_eng: Summary paste: ran a 45m steady-state run targeting 160 RPS (their stated steady) with 5k warmup + 40m steady. Observed metrics: median=110ms, p90=310ms, p95=480ms, p99=1.1s. Error rate 0.18% (mostly 429s during a ~2m spike).

nina_infra: Notes on spike: correlated with cache eviction events on the test pool at t=00:22:13. Eviction backlog + spike in KV miss ratio (~18% -> 35%) caused short tail behavior. We can mitigate by increasing shared KV to 10GB or configuring per-model pinning for hot prefixes.

owen_sre: Also saw occasional CPU steal on one worker during ramp tests; we rebalanced and it cleared. Canary fallback (20% to quantized) reduces p95 to ~260ms but induces a measurable BLEU drop on their eval snippets. Need product agreement for fallback.

maria_sales: Their acceptance checklist (from legal/ops): sustain 150 RPS p95<500ms, uptime 99.9% during acceptance, logs retained 90 days, EU data residency. They asked for a cost comparison reserved vs hosted.

lena_prod: Tradeoffs: we can meet perf easily with Dedicated reserved pool sized at ~4 A10g-equivalents for margin. Fallback policy will be opt-in for them; default rollout can be 10% traffic to fallback for quality checks.

kate_finance: Cost ballpark: Reserved monthly (12mo) ~ $38,500. On-demand hosted estimate (steady 150 RPS) adds ~60% premium; burst cost may be higher. I'll produce a formal pricing slide if you confirm expected token mix.

secbot: Security checklist update: KMS/BYOK supported only in Private or Dedicated VPC. Data residency: we can provision EU-only model pools; ETA for enabling EU-residency in acceptance window ~ 5 business days. Please confirm.

maria_sales: Action items for call: 1) Confirm whether Acme will accept Dedicated or needs hosted. 2) Provide committed RPS and estimated tokens/day. 3) Confirm EU-only requirement (if yes, need Dedicated).

tyler_eng: Repro steps and load command we used: ```
hey --workload-file acme_prompt_set.json --rps 160 --duration 2700 --concurrency 40 --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --header "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
```

owen_sre: Internal run artifact: https://internal.redwood/artefacts/2001234567/acme-perf.html (contains heatmaps + raw trace). TL;DR: passes p95 < 500ms once KV cache bump applied.

nina_infra: I'm going to spin a test pool with KV=10GB and prefix caching enabled and re-run a 20m validation at 160 RPS. ETA ~4h. Will post updated numbers.

lena_prod: Proposed acceptance criteria draft for legal: p95 <= 500ms sustained for 24h, error rate < 0.5%, successful semantic eval >= 94% on their reference set, EU-only data residency if required, and KMS integration documented.

kate_finance: For discount bands: send me expected committed RPS, average tokens per request, and expected months. I'll model reserve vs on-demand and include burst costs.

maria_sales: I'll ask Acme for token profile and confirm Dedicated requirement before the call. Thanks all — will update after Nina's validation run. :rocket:
